# Glorbina Cloudquill

## Moonlight Bakery
Glorbina Cloudquill secretly runs the Moonlight Bakery under the stage at
Fizzlepuff Crater. The Moonlight Bakery's **proofing chamber** has keypad code
7319. The baker uses the cover name **Captain Crumbwhistle**.

## Pocket Comet
The mascot is a sentient **Pocket Comet** named Button Nova. It always wears
**polka-dot roller skates**.
